name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape. Changelog (last 3): 7.259.0 — Mutation replay retired — the replay command, its script, corpus library and doctrine, the status-footer replay-due clause, fleet-reader's replay queries and review-legs' replay flag are removed; the escape ledger is the one ground-truth signal (ADR-0036). 7.257.0 — spec-status derives a fourth brief status, superseded, for roadmap briefs carrying a Superseded by banner with no spec in flight: the roadmap renders them as their own ⛔ collapsed run instead of folding them into the ⬜ unplanned count, the --next fallback pick never recommends planning one, and --json/--brief report the status as superseded. 7.256.0 — /spec:plan's lock now runs decision-lint.js: a Decisions row that withholds a user affordance must carry [guards: <host § Risk Tiers text>] or [asked: <choice>], and a deferral row must cite a queue id spec-queue resolves; the plan ledger row records decisionLint counts.
